<?php

namespace Dsl\App\Tools;

use Dsl\App\Exception\InvalidConfigurationException;
use Dsl\App\Exception\InvalidHostnameException;
use Dsl\App\Exception\UnresolvedPhpDependencyException;
use Dsl\App\Page;

class LdapUtility
{
    public const SERVERTYPE_OPENLDAP = 'OpenLDAP';
    public const SERVERTYPE_ACTIVE_DIRECTORY = 'Active Directory';

    protected const MAX_ENTRIES = 100;
    protected const ATTRIBUTES_DEFAULT = ['mail', 'cn'];


    /**
     * LDAP configuration
     *
     * @var array
     */
    protected $config;

    /**
     * LDAP connection ID
     *
     * @var resource|\LDAP\Connection
     */
    protected $connection;

    /**
     * LDAP server status
     *
     * @var array
     */
    protected $status;

    /**
     * 'OpenLDAP' OR 'Active Directory'
     * @var string
     */
    protected $serverType;


    /**
     * LDAP Server Search ID
     * @var resource|\LDAP\Result
     */
    protected $searchResult;

    /**
     * LDAP First Entry ID
     * @var resource|\LDAP\ResultEntry
     */
    protected $firstResultEntry;

    private function __construct($config = [])
    {
        $this->config = \array_replace_recursive(Page::$config['ldap'], $config);
    }

    /**
     * Connects to an LDAP server.
     *
     * @throws UnresolvedPhpDependencyException when LDAP extension for PHP is not available
     */
    public static function getInstance()
    {
        // Valid if php load ldap module.
        if (!extension_loaded('ldap')) {
            throw new UnresolvedPhpDependencyException(
                'Your PHP version seems to lack LDAP support. Please install/activate the extension.',
                1660930683903
            );
        }
        return new LdapUtility();
    }

    public function connect(): bool
    {
        $host = $this->config['host'];
        $port = $this->config['port'];
        $protocol = $this->config['protocol'] ?? 3;
        $serverType = $this->config['serverType'] ?? self::SERVERTYPE_OPENLDAP;
        $tls = $this->config['tls'] ?? false;
        $ssl = $this->config['ssl'] ?? false;
        $tlsReqcert = $this->config['tlsReqcert'] ?? false;

        // Errorhandling
        if (!$host) {
            throw new InvalidConfigurationException('Host needs to be configured.');
        }
        if (!$port) {
            throw new InvalidConfigurationException('Port needs to be configured.');
        }

        return $this->_connect($host, $port, $protocol, $serverType, $tls, $ssl, $tlsReqcert);
    }

    /**
     * Connects to an LDAP server.
     *
     * @param string $host
     * @param int $port
     * @param int $protocol 3 for LDAP v3
     * @param string $serverType Either 'OpenLDAP' or 'Active Directory'
     * @param bool $tls
     * @param bool $ssl
     * @param bool $tlsReqcert
     * @return bool true if connection succeeded.
     * @throws InvalidHostnameException when LDAP host is invalid
     */
    private function _connect(
        string $host,
        int $port,
        int $protocol,
        bool $serverType,
        bool $tls,
